landing.heroTitle: Track your plays like never before
landing.heroSub: BG Watch is {{brandName}}'s play tracker. Connect your BoardGameGeek account and log, edit and explore everything you've played — without leaving the app.

plays.title: Log your plays
plays.body: Log, edit and delete plays right from {{brandName}}. They sync with your BoardGameGeek account.

collection.title: Your collection, always at hand
collection.body: See the games you own, with ratings, number of plays and thumbnails.

perGame.title: A per-game view
perGame.body: Filter your play history by title, with score, position, players and notes for each session.

landing.ctaLoggedSub: Go to your profile, enter your BoardGameGeek username and connect your account to start logging plays.
landing.ctaFinePrint: Don't have a BoardGameGeek account yet?
landing.ctaGuestSub: Sign up for free on {{brandName}} and connect your BoardGameGeek account from your profile. It's quick.
landing.step1Body: Enter your BoardGameGeek username and password. We store the password encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and never send it to the browser.
landing.step2Body: We pull your collection and your plays from BGG. You'll see it all in an interface built for use from your phone, while you play.
landing.step3Body: As soon as the table wraps up, log the play from {{brandName}}. It's saved to BGG automatically.
landing.footnote: BoardGameGeek is an external service. BG Watch is {{brandName}}'s integration with its API.
